data.name: Kathiravan
data.gender_notes: Kathiravan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kathiravan is the name of a prince from Tamil mythology, who was sent by his father, Lord Indra, to rescue his wife, Mohini, from the demon king Iravadhaman. The name 'Kathiravan' means 'shining like the sun' or 'rays ofof.sun'. The name Kathiravan carries the meaning “Shining like the sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil Mythology tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kathiravan usually hope their child will grow to embody shining like the sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kathiravan belongs to the Tamil Mythology linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shining like the sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kathiravan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: Kathiravan is a popular character in Tamil literature and folklore. His story, which involves tests of loyalty, courage, and devotion, has been passed down through generations through oral traditions and written works. In modern times, Kathiravan has become a beloved hero in Tamil Nadu, and his story continues to inspire artists and storytellers. His tale of rescuing his wife and battling evil illustrates the importance of preserving relationships, protecting loved ones, and standing up against adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu mythology, Kathiravan's name embodies the qualities of the sun. It represents light, power, and illumination. The sun is a symbol of the divine consciousness that illuminates all things. By adopting the name Kathiravan, one may symbolically embrace these qualities. Additionally, the story of Kathiravan highlights the power of devotion and loyalty to one's loved ones and the divine. Through this character's life, themes of courage, selflessness, and resilience in the face of adversity can be explored and explored.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kathiravan, meaning 'the radiant one', symbolizes the inner light and purity that shines within every person, guiding them through life's challenges. This name is a reminder to live in truth and righteousness, illuminating the path for others.
